items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Jeff Beck, that's the one that sold, isn't it? ... Is Jeff Beck a guitar player?

ctx.x: "Duke's Sound of Love," yeah. That's a nice song. That's right. Were you surprised to find out that Jeff Beck had done "Porkpie Hat" on that album that he'd done?
Jeff Beck, that's the one that sold, isn't it?
That's the one that sold all those millions of copies. I guess that album went platinum.
